failure.class: spec-interpretation (data format, shared by model and RTL)
failure.what: The weight words in data/cnn_params.hex are signed 8-bit values written zero-extended in 32-bit words (range 0 to 255, 310 of 612 above 127). The agent's model.py and cnn_core.sv sign-extended from bit 31, so every weight 128 to 255 read as positive and the network always chose class 2. With bytes sign-extended from bit 7 the agent's own model.py classifies the eight pictures 0,0,1,1,2,2,3,3. The spec says only that biases are 32-bit signed and does not state the weight width. Model and RTL agree, so no internal gate could catch it. The UART_TXD_IN port gap of run 1 is closed (FDA-CON-9): the hidden bench elaborated.
